mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Open one ABAP short dump by its id and see its details.

description: [read-only] Reads the ABAP short dump (runtime error) named by dump_id in the view given. Required: dump_id* (id or URI). Optional: view(default|summary|formatted). Response: JSON. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

dump_id.description: The dump's dump_id, or its URI.

view.description: "summary" — runtime error, exception, terminated program, time, user and termination position; "default" — that summary and the parsed dump; "formatted" — the dump as formatted text.

name: HandlerDumpView
